name: Sailor Moon Dating Simulator 3
source:
The goal of the game is to win love of Aino Minako by asking her out on dates, giving her gifts or playing mini-games.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130507224522/https://sailorvgame.org/mg/smds/smds3.htm]Sailorvgame.org[/url]]
translation:
游戏目标是通过邀请爱野美奈子约会、赠送礼物或游玩小游戏，赢得她的爱情。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130507224522/https://sailorvgame.org/mg/smds/smds3.htm]Sailorvgame.org[/url]]
